translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

content: Natiṽosan
Nǝboŋ aYesu tokǝmaienan tonoŋ, eriŋ naut a Kalili, evi Jutea len naut tarhǝwisel Jortan.
Nab̃iltiluṽoh gail lohusuri, ale igol galit lumaur ei.
Beti naFarisi galevis logǝm hǝn aYesu, lolǝŋon ke tekǝkos len nasoruan san, mǝdas nahǝsan ale lousi ke, “Inor hǝn aulum̃an b̃etiṽos hǝn asoan, riŋ gab̃ulani husur nǝnauan o nalǝŋonian sitenan ŋai a?
Ris aYesu tosor var galit ke, “Mǝtsaṽuruŋ natosian siGot toke ‘sutuai len natub̃atan aGot igol naulum̃an mai napǝhaṽut a?’
Ale aGot ike, ‘Bathut natenan, naulum̃an dereh teriŋ atǝman mai anan hǝn b̃eudud mai asoan, ale aresua sum̃an artovi niben tosua ŋai.’
Husur arsaru am, arosua ŋai. Imagenan, naududan aGot togole, nǝvanuan satepǝpehuni.”
Ale lousi ke, “B̃imagenan, aMoses ikel nalo toke, ‘Naulum̃an tilav nalob̃ulat hǝn natiṽosan mai asoan ale tesǝvati van,’ ikele husur nǝsa?”
AYesu ikel mai galit ke, “AMoses idam̃ hǝni ke mǝttotiṽos hǝn asoamito husur nǝkadumit ihaihai masuṽ, avil sutuai len natub̃atan, sǝmaienan.
Be nukel mai gamito ke naulum̃an ideh totiṽos hǝn asoan naut kǝmas alitenan sagol naitian tosa, ale tolah mai napǝhaṽut ideh am, atenan igol naitian tob̃ur kotov nǝlahan.”
Ahai susur san gail lukel maii ke, “Nǝlahan naulum̃an tokade mai asoan b̃imaienan, nǝlahan tob̃uer ivoi am.”
Ris aYesu tosor var galit ke, “Savi nǝvanuan p̃isi lolǝboi lǝb̃esǝsǝloŋ sǝhot nap̃usanan enan, be aGot ilav nǝdaŋan mai galevis ŋai hǝn lǝb̃elǝboi lǝb̃igole.

Husur sogsog galevis lovi sogsog nǝboŋ analit lotopas galito, be sogsog galevis am, nǝvanuan gail lugol lotovi sogsog. Ale ikad galevis tile am lǝsǝlah m̃os natohan pipihabǝlan aGot len nǝmav gol ke len nǝmauran salito losum̃an sogsog gail. Avan ideh tolǝboi b̃esǝsǝloŋ sǝhot natenan, tesǝsǝloŋ sǝhoti!”
AYesu mai alahutai
Beti nǝvanuan galevis losǝhar atuhlahutai van hǝn aYesu hǝn b̃eriŋ navǝlan gǝlaru len galito ale sor tuṽ. Avil ahai susur gail losivoh len galito.
Be aYesu ike, “Mitidam̃ hǝn alahutai lǝb̃egǝm hǝn ginau; samteil gol galito! Husur natohan pipihabǝlan aGot len nǝmav evi silat lotosum̃an alategai.”
Ale nǝboŋ aYesu toriŋ navǝlan gǝlaru len galito tonoŋ, eriŋ naut enan, ivan.
Nǝmantuhmar topul hǝn natite
Len nǝboŋ sua, aulum̃an sua egǝm hǝn aYesu eusi ke, “Hai p̃usan, nigol natit tovoi sa hǝn nǝb̃ikad nǝmauran vi sutuai?”
AYesu isor vari ke, “Imabe gotous ginau husur natit tovoi? Ikad Atesua ŋai tovoi. Be gǝb̃ike gǝb̃evi lan nǝmauran vi sutuai, gigol nǝsa nakelean todaŋ gail siGot tokele.”
Ike, “Nakelean todaŋ gail ta be?” Ale aYesu ike, “Sagigol avan ideh timat,
sagigol naitian tob̃ur kotov nǝlahan, sagevǝnah, sageliboŋ len nakotan,
geputsan atǝmam̃ mai anam̃ len nǝnauan sam̃, ale lǝmas bun nǝvanuan totoh pǝpadaŋ hǝn gaiug sum̃an gotolǝmas bun gaiug gabag.”
Nǝmantuhmar ikel maii ke, “Nugol natgalen p̃isi tia. Nǝsa ipat sal hǝn nǝb̃igole?”

AYesu ikel maii ke, “Gǝb̃ike gǝb̃inor kavkav len nǝhon aGot, gia p̃ur hǝn natit p̃isi sam̃, ale viol hǝn nǝvat han mai namǝsal gail. Ale dereh gikad nakonviolan aGot totǝgau gati m̃os gaiug len nǝmav. Beti gegǝm husur ginau.”
Nǝboŋ nǝmantuhmar tosǝsǝloŋ hǝn natenan, ivan, elǝŋon isa habat husur epul hǝn natite, ikad nasugsugur isob̃ur.
Ale aYesu isor mai ahai susur san gail, ike, “Nukel nakitinan mai gamit ke, idaŋ habat hǝn avan ideh topul hǝn natite b̃eb̃is len natohan pipihabǝlan aGot len nǝmav.”
Ikele am ke, “Idaŋ habat hǝn nǝkamel b̃eb̃is tur len nab̃urhunil sǝsod. Idaŋ sǝhori am hǝn nǝvanuan topul hǝn natite b̃eb̃is len natohan pipihabǝlan aGot.”
Nǝboŋ lotosǝsǝloŋ hǝni, ahai susur gail lup̃aŋ habat, luke, “B̃imaienan, as teb̃is lan? Sǝkad avan ideh b̃ikad nǝmauran vi sutuai!”
Beti aYesu ekǝta bunus galito ike, “Len nǝvanuan gail, galit lodǝdas lǝb̃igol natenan, avil aGot elǝboi b̃igol natit p̃isi.”
Ale aPita isor vari ke, “Geris, ginamit namtoriŋ natit p̃isi hǝn namttohusur gaiug. Dereh tikad nǝsa sinamito?”

Beti aYesu ikel mai galit ke, “Nukel nakitinan mai gamito ke, len nǝboŋ navile a pan b̃iveveu, nǝboŋ aNatun Nǝvanuan b̃ebǝtah len nab̃iltihai bǝtbǝtah san toyalyal hum akiŋ, gamit am mǝttohusur ginau, dereh mǝtebǝtah len nab̃iltihai bǝtbǝtah gail lotovi 12 hǝn mǝtb̃epǝpehun navoian dan nǝsaan len nahǝmar lotovi 12 seIsrael.
Ale avan ideh toriŋ naim gail o aṽan gail o aṽavinen gail o atǝman o anan o anatun gail o nǝtan m̃os nahǝsagw, dereh aGot teviol hǝn vǝha-100 maii, ale aGot teviol am hǝn nǝmauran vi sutuai maii.
Ale nab̃iltivanuan isob̃ur gagai, asike lovi natideh; ale isob̃ur lǝsavi natideh gagai, dereh legǝm vi b̃iltivanuan.”

footnotes.text: 19.3 Natiṽosan evi na-tos-gati-an hǝn napǝpehwan silarmisoan sua hǝn asike arb̃ilah am.
19.12 Sogsog evi nabuai o nab̃uluk o naulum̃an ideh sǝkad nǝdavurhut naloson husur lototev kotovi.
19.18 Nǝboŋ toke Sagigol avan ideh timat namilen ke sagigol avan ideh timat sil nǝlol paŋpaŋ sam̃ o nalǝŋonian sam̃ ŋai.
